scripts.logs:api: ssh ubuntu@web.luminano.xyz "export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config; kubectl logs -f -l app=luminano-api --tail=100"
scripts.logs:web: ssh ubuntu@web.luminano.xyz "export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config; kubectl logs -f -l app=luminano-web --tail=100"
scripts.db:push:prod: ssh ubuntu@web.luminano.xyz "export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config; kubectl exec -i deployment/luminano-api -- pnpm --filter @luminano/database db:push"
